title: Student Sleep and Wellbeing Statistical Analysis in R
subtitle: Completed master's coursework project · R Programming & Statistical Analysis
description: R-based statistical analysis project studying the relationship between sleep habits, emotional wellbeing and academic performance in university students, including data cleaning, imputation, hypothesis testing and regression modeling.
highlights: Performed exploratory analysis and variable type definition for a university student sleep and wellbeing dataset.
Detected constant and near-constant variables, anomalous values and missing data patterns.
Applied multiple imputation using mice and assessed normality using Shapiro-Wilk tests.
Used Box-Cox transformations, Pearson correlation and multiple linear regression.
Applied Kruskal-Wallis, ANOVA, Levene and Wilcoxon / Mann-Whitney tests.
Summarized sleep, wellbeing and academic performance relationships with visual reporting.
